title: Supply Chain Attack on serd
technical_mechanism: -- # `serd` was removed from crates.io for malicious code This crate was part of a typosquatting malware cluster published by the malicious user `amaperf` and contained a malware payload in build.rs to exfiltrate host information to the attacker. This advisory is to retrospectively document this attemp
